decks.name: LeetCode #7 - Reverse Integer
decks.description: Reverse the digits of a signed 32-bit integer, returning 0 if overflow occurs

cards.question: Reverse Integer: Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the signed 32-bit integer range [-2^31, 2^31 - 1], then return 0.

solutions.name: Iteration
